evals.prompt: /vibe-diff  (sandbox: branch feat/add-logging, no openspec/ anywhere and no .review/ mini-spec; last test run given at invocation: bash test.sh, pass, 3 tests)
evals.expected_output: With neither an OpenSpec change nor a saved .review/<slug>/mini-spec.md, the hardened vibe-diff refuses to run rather than reviewing against nothing: it writes no review artifact, leaves the repo tree untouched, and points the user at the fix (run /begin to save a mini-spec, or open an OpenSpec change, then re-invoke).

expectations.text: No vibe-diff artifact is written under .review/feat-add-logging/; the run refuses rather than writing a review
The repo tree is left untouched (no review artifact written anywhere, not even a fallback directory)
The run reports it cannot build a review without a spec source (no OpenSpec change and no saved mini-spec), rather than reviewing anyway

check.regex: (?i)(nothing to check it against|not a review|no (active )?(open ?spec|spec|change)|refuse)

expectations.text: The refusal points at the fix: run /begin to save a mini-spec, or open an OpenSpec change

evals.prompt: /vibe-diff  (sandbox: branch feat/add-metrics, no openspec/ anywhere but a saved .review/feat-add-metrics/mini-spec.md describing the intended change, and a small diff on the branch; last test run given at invocation: bash test.sh, pass, 3 tests)
evals.expected_output: With no OpenSpec change but a saved mini-spec as the spec source, vibe-diff runs its two-layer path: it captures the branch diff against the merge-base to diff.patch, authors a diff-review.json that maps the change to the mini-spec's stated intent (carrying an honest test_status and an unverified quarantine bucket), and renders the self-contained diff-review.html, all under .review/feat-add-metrics/. The page explains the diff, it does not judge it: no approve/block verdict, and every hunk id it uses comes from the generator's printed contract, none invented.

expectations.text: The branch diff is captured to a file rather than worked from memory
The judgment layer diff-review.json is authored under the resolved artifact dir
diff-review.json carries the test_status field and the unverified quarantine bucket the schema requires
test_status records the test run (command/when/result) or an honest unobtainable, never a bare green
The self-contained diff-review.html is rendered under the artifact dir
The rendered page is a real page, not a stub skeleton
The page explains the diff against the mini-spec's intent and renders no approve/block verdict

check.rubric: The review must map the diff to the mini-spec's stated intent (what count_greetings was asked to do) in its overview and intent map, and it must not render an approve, block, 'looks good', or 'must fix' verdict. vibe-diff explains, it never judges. Judged from diff-review.json and the run summary: an account that decodes the diff against the spec passes; one that pronounces a merge verdict fails.

expectations.text: Every hunk id used comes from the generator's printed authoring contract; none is invented

check.rubric: Any hunk id referenced in diff-review.json (in intent_map or hotspots) must be one the generator printed in its authoring contract, used verbatim, not a hand-invented id. Evidence: the render loop should end clean, with no unresolved 'id not found' or unplaced-annotation problems left in the output. Judged from the transcript's render output and the JSON.
